Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. On November 13, 2026, Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (the “ Company ” or “ Lowe’s ”) appointed Margrethe (Margi) Vagell as Executive Vice President, Merchandising, effective November 14, 2026, succeeding William P. Boltz as part of his planned retirement. Ms. Vagell will also retain her responsibilities for Supply Chain, including the Company’s logistics, distribution centers, transportation and delivery services, and inventory replenishment and planning. Mr. Boltz will work closely with Ms. Vagell in the coming months to support a seamless transition. Following this transition, Mr. Boltz will serve as President of the Lowe’s Foundation (the “ Foundation ”), effective January 30, 2027. His appointment reinforces his long-standing commitment to the Foundation and its mission to build the skilled trades workforce. These leadership changes are designed to further connect the capabilities the Company has built through its Total Home Strategy and accelerate execution across the business.
